facts.business: RR MetalMakers India Limited is engaged in the business of metal trading and manufacturing.

auditor.name: M/s. M.A Chavan & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Revenue recognized for export sales to Samaira International Limited (Rs. 1,354.70 lakhs) and Grandmark Global PTE Ltd. (Rs. 275.52 lakhs) where goods have not been transferred to the customer as on the date of the audit report, leading to overstatement of revenue from operations and trade receivables.

key_risks: Revenue recognition for export sales without transfer of goods to customers
Overstatement of revenue from operations and trade receivables
